description: Budgets-as-rules, data form v0. Rule file is the policy — he who edits the rule file edits the law, ledger rows record it. Desk floors (floor, not ceiling — cc-slidev values may tighten). Theme registry v0: exactly two named palettes marked PROVISIONAL (until Commander's theme notes): anchor + slate, 5 fixed hexes each. Disparities vs cc-slidev logged in ledgers with sources. F1/F2 lesson on record: a 4,000-char bullet saves silently — budgets are computed at outline time so the box never decides silently later.

rules.text: Max bullets per slide ≤6 — content decides count, box never decides silently later (F1/F2 lesson).
Max chars per slide ≤400 — budgets computed at outline time so the box never decides silently later.
Max chars per bullet ≤80 — prevents 4,000-char bullet that saves silently (F1/F2).
Max slides per deck: content decides (no cap) — claim-list slides may each cite ONE receipt.
Theme must be from theme registry v0 — anchor or slate PROVISIONAL until Commander's theme notes.
Fixed hex set per theme (theme_lock) — locked palettes, content decides count, doctrine: theme_lock.

anchor.note: PROVISIONAL (until the Commander's theme notes) — warm anchor palette for Nota answer-format decks

slate.note: PROVISIONAL (until the Commander's theme notes) — cool slate palette for Nota answer-format decks

disparities_vs_cc_slidev.note: Desk floor matches cc-slidev tight value — floor, not ceiling, cc-slidev may tighten further per ledger
Desk floor 400 chars per slide aligns with cc-slidev visual budget — computed at outline time
F1/F2 lesson: 4,000-char bullet saves silently — desk floor 80 prevents silent box decision

honesty_note: A deck is a Nota answer format, not a product. No .pptx-alone delivery — the outline always ships with the deck. The outline is the receipt; the deck is its rendering. Theme registry v0 marked PROVISIONAL until Commander's theme notes. Budgets computed at outline time so box never decides silently later.
